asset_rows.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: single production reference photograph for a restrained, realistic contemporary Chinese lacquer craft film, W01 environment master. Create ONE clean landscape 16:9 photograph, no collage, no labels or text. An ordinary small actively used contemporary Pingyao lacquer workshop, not a museum or ancient fantasy: plain light gray plaster walls, a dark brown solid wood rectangular workbench across the foreground, a landscape rectangular charcoal-gray non-slip work mat centered on the bench. A simple wooden grid window is on the LEFT wall, with only two columns and three rows of panes, admitting controlled soft daylight from the left. Modest weak ambient fill, deep but readable shadows. At back right a plain brown wooden drying/storage cabinet with shelves and simple doors; one door slightly ajar, cabinet interior dim and dry, not lit by direct sun. A few unobtrusive practical hand tools at the far edge of the bench, no clutter, no identifiable logos. No person and NO lacquer board on the mat yet; the empty pad provides the consistent place for a 30 by 20 cm board in subsequent assets. Camera near operator height, slightly above the bench, three-quarter wide view; bench foreground and left window spatial relation clearly visible, natural straight perspective. Neutral blacks, soft gray, dark brown; quiet contemporary documentary realism, believable wood grain and subtle working wear. No floating dust, haze, smoke, incense, red lanterns, elaborate antique decoration, fake historic garments, gold particles, heavy film grain, lens flare, overexposure, typography or watermark.
asset_rows.qa: 静态检查；视频连续性及手机可辨性尚待样片验证
